channel.title: Di Antara Dua Cinta
channel.desc: On the second anniversary of Shafira and her husband Rafael's wedding, Shafira received news that Rafael had been in an accident and his body could not be found. Several years passed, Rafael was still missing and presumed dead. Shafira decided to marry Julian. Suddenly, Rafael reappeared in her life!
